We present a new BDDlike data structure called Hybrid-Restriction Diagrams (HRDs) that allows to represent and manipulate linear hybrid systems (LHSs).

(i) HRDs are a novel, efficient data structure for representing and manipulating LHA state spaces; (ii) HRDs can be used to efficiently compute symbolic weakest preconditions of linear constraints over parameters of LHA; and (iii) our implementation of HRDs is more efficient than the state-of-the-art symbolic parametric safety analysis algorithms for LHA.
